description: Trip Service (port 4003), Booking Service (port 4004), Payment Service (port 4005), and Notification Service (port 4006). These four services form the core booking pipeline and are built together because they communicate via the shared event bus. Order of data flow: Trip → Booking → Payment → Notification. Each uses its own logical MongoDB database. Depends on FEAT-001 (shared packages).
steps: --- TRIP SERVICE ---
1. Create services/trip-service/package.json: name '@terno/trip-service', type 'module', port 4003. Dependencies: express, mongoose, zod, cors, dotenv, morgan, cookie-parser. Add @terno/shared.
2. Create services/trip-service/tsconfig.json.
3. Create services/trip-service/.env.example: PORT=4003, MONGODB_URI, INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET, FRONTEND_URL, NODE_ENV.
4. Create services/trip-service/src/config/env.ts and src/config/database.ts (dbName: 'terno_trips').

5. Create services/trip-service/src/models/Trip.ts — full Mongoose schema matching ITrip interface from @terno/shared. Fields: title, slug (auto-generated from title, unique), destination, country, coverImage (String, default picsum 800x600), images ([String]), description, category (enum), duration (Number), maxGroupSize (Number), pricePerPerson (Number), discountPrice (Number optional), itinerary ([{ day, title, description, accommodation? }]), inclusions ([String]), exclusions ([String]), accommodationType (String), difficulty (enum Easy/Moderate/Challenging), startDates ([Date]), availableSeats (Number), ratingsAverage (Number default 4.5), ratingsQuantity (Number default 0), cancellationPolicy (String), isActive (Boolean default true), createdAt, updatedAt. Index on: destination, category, pricePerPerson, isActive.
6. Create services/trip-service/src/models/Review.ts — schema: tripId, userId, userName, rating (1-5), comment, createdAt. Index on tripId.
7. Create services/trip-service/src/middleware/extractUser.ts and errorHandler.ts (same pattern as auth-service).

8. Create services/trip-service/src/services/trip.service.ts — business logic: getAllTrips(filters, pagination): builds query from searchTripsSchema fields (text search on title+destination, category filter, price range, duration), returns paginated result. getTripBySlug(slug). getTripById(id). checkAvailability(tripId, departureDate, seats): validates date is in startDates and availableSeats >= seats. decrementSeats(tripId, seats): atomic findOneAndUpdate with $inc. createTrip, updateTrip, deleteTrip (admin).

9. Create services/trip-service/src/controllers/trip.controller.ts — handlers: listTrips (GET, public), getTrip (GET /:slug, public), getFeaturedTrips (GET /featured — isActive:true, sorted by ratingsAverage, limit 6), getTrendingTrips (GET /trending — sorted by ratingsQuantity, limit 4), getCategories (GET /categories — distinct categories), checkAvailability (POST /check-availability — internal+public), decrementSeats (POST /internal/decrement-seats — serviceAuth). Admin: createTrip, updateTrip, deleteTrip.

10. Create services/trip-service/src/routes/trip.routes.ts — GET /api/v1/trips, GET /api/v1/trips/featured, GET /api/v1/trips/trending, GET /api/v1/trips/categories, GET /api/v1/trips/:slug, POST /api/v1/trips/check-availability, POST /api/v1/internal/trips/decrement-seats (serviceAuth), POST /api/v1/internal/trips/increment-seats (serviceAuth — for cancellations).

11. Create services/trip-service/src/seeders/trips.seed.ts — seed script with 12 rich sample trips covering all categories (Adventure, Beach, Cultural, Wildlife, City, Mountain, Budget) with realistic data: destinations like Manali, Goa, Rajasthan, Kerala, Ladakh, Andaman, etc. Use picsum.photos URLs for images (e.g. https://picsum.photos/seed/manali/800/600). Each trip has 3 startDates (future dates), full itinerary (3-7 days), inclusions, exclusions, cancellationPolicy. Export a runSeed() function. Also add a check so seed only runs if Trip collection is empty.
12. Call runSeed() on startup (after DB connect) in trip-service src/index.ts.
13. Create services/trip-service/src/app.ts and src/index.ts.
--- BOOKING SERVICE ---
14. Create services/booking-service/package.json: name '@terno/booking-service', type 'module', port 4004. Add @terno/shared and @terno/shared-events.
15. Create services/booking-service/tsconfig.json.
16. Create services/booking-service/.env.example: PORT=4004, MONGODB_URI, INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET, TRIP_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4003, PAYMENT_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4005, NODE_ENV.
17. Create services/booking-service/src/config/env.ts and src/config/database.ts (dbName: 'terno_bookings').

18. Create services/booking-service/src/models/Booking.ts — Mongoose schema: bookingRef (String, unique, indexed — generated via generateBookingRef()), userId (String, required, indexed), tripId (String, required), tripSnapshot ({ title, destination, coverImage, pricePerPerson, duration }), departureDate (Date, required), travellers ([{ firstName, lastName, age, passportNumber? }]), totalAmount (Number, required), status (enum: Pending|Confirmed|Cancelled|Refunded, default: Pending), paymentStatus (enum: Pending|Paid|Refunded|Failed, default: Pending), contactEmail (String, required), contactPhone (String, required), specialRequests (String), paymentId (String), cancellationReason (String), createdAt, updatedAt.

19. Create services/booking-service/src/services/booking.service.ts — createBooking(data, userId): 1) call trip-service GET /api/v1/trips/check-availability to validate trip exists + seats available + get current price, 2) calculate server-side totalAmount = pricePerPerson * travellers.length, 3) create Booking with status Pending, 4) emit BOOKING_CREATED event on eventBus, 5) return booking. getUserBookings(userId, pagination). getBookingById(id, userId). cancelBooking(id, userId): validate status is Pending/Confirmed, set status Cancelled, emit BOOKING_CANCELLED, call trip-service increment-seats. updateBookingPaymentStatus(bookingId, paymentStatus, paymentId): called internally by payment-service.

20. Create services/booking-service/src/controllers/booking.controller.ts — handlers: createBooking (POST, extractUser), getMyBookings (GET /my, extractUser), getBookingByRef (GET /:ref, extractUser), cancelBooking (DELETE /:id, extractUser). Internal: updatePaymentStatus (POST /internal/update-payment, serviceAuth).

21. Create services/booking-service/src/routes/booking.routes.ts — POST /api/v1/bookings, GET /api/v1/bookings/my, GET /api/v1/bookings/:ref, DELETE /api/v1/bookings/:id, POST /api/v1/internal/bookings/update-payment.
22. Create services/booking-service/src/middleware/extractUser.ts, serviceAuth.ts, errorHandler.ts.

23. Create services/booking-service/src/app.ts and src/index.ts. In index.ts, after DB connect, register event bus listeners: listen for PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED → call updateBookingPaymentStatus(bookingId, 'Paid', paymentId) and set status 'Confirmed'. Listen for PAYMENT_FAILED → set paymentStatus 'Failed'.
--- PAYMENT SERVICE ---
24. Create services/payment-service/package.json: name '@terno/payment-service', type 'module', port 4005. Add @terno/shared and @terno/shared-events.
25. Create services/payment-service/tsconfig.json.
26. Create services/payment-service/.env.example: PORT=4005, MONGODB_URI, INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET, BOOKING_SERVICE_URL=http://localhost:4004, NODE_ENV, PAYMENT_PROVIDER=mock.
27. Create services/payment-service/src/config/env.ts and src/config/database.ts (dbName: 'terno_payments').

28. Create services/payment-service/src/models/Payment.ts — schema: paymentRef (String, unique), bookingId (String, required, indexed), userId (String, required), amount (Number, required), currency (String, default: 'INR'), provider (String, default: 'mock'), status (enum: Pending|Success|Failed|Refunded, default: Pending), providerOrderId (String), providerPaymentId (String), failureReason (String), metadata (Mixed), createdAt, updatedAt.

29. Create services/payment-service/src/providers/PaymentProvider.interface.ts — TypeScript interface IPaymentProvider with methods: createOrder(bookingId, amount, currency, metadata): Promise<{ orderId, amount, currency, providerData }>. capturePayment(orderId, scenario): Promise<PaymentResult>. refund(paymentId): Promise<RefundResult>.

30. Create services/payment-service/src/providers/MockPaymentProvider.ts — implements IPaymentProvider. createOrder: generates a mock orderId (MOCK-ORD-XXXX), returns immediately. capturePayment(orderId, scenario): scenario can be 'success'|'failure'|'pending'|'timeout'. success: 200ms delay then return { status: 'Success', paymentId: 'MOCK-PAY-XXXX' }. failure: return { status: 'Failed', reason: 'Insufficient funds (mock)' }. pending: return { status: 'Pending' }. timeout: 3000ms delay then throw Error('Payment timeout'). Default scenario is 'success'. Add a comment: 'MOCK PROVIDER — replace with real gateway (Razorpay, Stripe, etc.) in production'.

31. Create services/payment-service/src/services/payment.service.ts — createOrder(bookingId, userId, amount): creates Payment record (Pending), calls provider.createOrder, returns { paymentId (internal), orderId, amount }. processPayment(internalPaymentId, scenario): calls provider.capturePayment, updates Payment status, emits PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED or PAYMENT_FAILED on eventBus. refundPayment(paymentId): validates status is Success, calls provider.refund, emits PAYMENT_REFUNDED (or reuse PAYMENT_FAILED with refund flag), updates status.

32. Create services/payment-service/src/controllers/payment.controller.ts — createOrder (POST /orders), processPayment (POST /orders/:id/process — body: { scenario? }), getPaymentStatus (GET /orders/:id), refundPayment (POST /orders/:id/refund — internal or admin).

33. Create services/payment-service/src/routes/payment.routes.ts — POST /api/v1/payments/orders, POST /api/v1/payments/orders/:id/process, GET /api/v1/payments/orders/:id, POST /api/v1/internal/payments/refund.
34. Create services/payment-service/src/app.ts and src/index.ts.
--- NOTIFICATION SERVICE ---
35. Create services/notification-service/package.json: name '@terno/notification-service', type 'module', port 4006. Add @terno/shared and @terno/shared-events.
36. Create services/notification-service/tsconfig.json.
37. Create services/notification-service/.env.example: PORT=4006, MONGODB_URI, INTERNAL_SERVICE_SECRET, NODE_ENV.
38. Create services/notification-service/src/config/env.ts and src/config/database.ts (dbName: 'terno_notifications').

39. Create services/notification-service/src/models/Notification.ts — schema: userId (String, required, indexed), title (String, required), message (String, required), type (enum: booking|payment|system, default: system), read (Boolean, default: false), metadata (Mixed), createdAt.

40. Create services/notification-service/src/services/notification.service.ts — createNotification(userId, title, message, type, metadata). getUserNotifications(userId, page, limit): returns paginated, sorted by createdAt desc. markAsRead(notificationId, userId). markAllAsRead(userId). getUnreadCount(userId).

41. Create services/notification-service/src/controllers/notification.controller.ts — getNotifications (GET /), getUnreadCount (GET /unread-count), markRead (PATCH /:id/read), markAllRead (PATCH /read-all). Internal: createNotification (POST /internal/notifications).

42. Create services/notification-service/src/routes/notification.routes.ts — GET /api/v1/notifications, GET /api/v1/notifications/unread-count, PATCH /api/v1/notifications/:id/read, PATCH /api/v1/notifications/read-all, POST /api/v1/internal/notifications (serviceAuth).

43. Create services/notification-service/src/eventHandlers.ts — register handlers on shared eventBus: BOOKING_CREATED → create notification for user ('Booking Received', 'Your booking for {trip} has been received and is pending payment.'). PAYMENT_SUCCEEDED → create notification ('Payment Confirmed', 'Your payment of ₹{amount} was successful. Booking {ref} is confirmed.'). PAYMENT_FAILED → create notification ('Payment Failed', 'Your payment for booking {ref} failed. Please try again.'). BOOKING_CANCELLED → create notification ('Booking Cancelled', 'Your booking {ref} has been cancelled.').
44. Create services/notification-service/src/app.ts and src/index.ts. In index.ts, after DB connect, call registerEventHandlers().

findings: CROSS-PROCESS EVENT BUS: The in-memory EventEmitter from @terno/shared-events cannot cross OS process boundaries. Each service gets its own isolated instance. Workaround implemented: booking-service and payment-service make direct HTTP POST calls to notification-service (/api/v1/internal/notifications) and booking-service (/api/v1/internal/bookings/update-payment) using Node built-in fetch with AbortSignal.timeout(5000). Failures are logged but do not crash the service. The eventHandlers.ts in notification-service retains the in-process EventEmitter registrations for documentation purposes and future monolith/test mode. To replace with a real broker, swap the HTTP fetch calls in booking-service and payment-service with broker.publish() and replace eventHandlers.ts subscriptions with broker.subscribe(). TypeScript fix: Mongoose .lean() returns FlattenMaps<T>[] which is not directly castable to custom Document types — fixed by using 'as unknown as T[]' intermediate cast.
